nodes.title: Possess
nodes.subtitle: Target is Controller
nodes.tooltip:
Handles attaching this controller to the specified pawn.
Only runs on the network authority (where HasAuthority() returns true).
Derived native classes can override OnPossess to filter the specified pawn.
When possessed pawn changed, blueprint class gets notified by ReceivePossess
and OnNewPawn delegate is broadcasted.

nodes.title: Get Player Controller
nodes.tooltip:
Returns the player controller found while iterating through the local and available remote player controllers.
On a network client, this will only include local players as remote player controllers are not available.
The index will be consistent as long as no new players join or leave, but it will not be the same across different clients and servers.

inputs.name: Player Index
inputs.tooltip: Index in the player controller list, starting first with local players and then available remote ones
